title: Builder Extended Rate Lock Charge Waivers — Ledger Standard
content:
Waivers on the Builder Extended Rate Lock ledger act on individual charges, each identified by its printed charge number.

## Standards in force

1. Relock, float-down and program change charges are never waived.
2. Each waiver names the charge number it waives.
3. A charge is waived at most once and a charge already collected at funding is not waived.

## Retired clause

> An extension charge is waived at the term's builder-delay waiver percent when the purchase agreement's scheduled closing date moved later because of a builder delay and the extension was needed to reach the new closing date.

This clause is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the builder-delay waiver.

## Applying standard 3

The test is made on the lock ledger, by charge number, before a waiver is written:

| The ledger already shows, for that charge number | The charge may be waived under standard 3 |
|---|---|
| neither a waiver nor a collection at funding | Yes |
| a waiver | No — a charge is waived at most once |
| a collection at funding | No |

## Basis questions

**Can a relock fee charge be waived?** No. Relock, float-down and program change charges are never waived.

**How is the charge identified on the waiver?** By the charge number printed for it, for example a number in the form LCK-CHG-7781; the waiver names that number.

superseded_clauses: An extension charge is waived at builder_delay_waiver_pct percent when the purchase agreement's scheduled closing date moved later because of a builder delay and the extension was needed to reach the new closing date
